Title: Easily deploy and manage Azure Stack through Avanade

Body.Content:
Avanade, a cloud services partner, now a way to easily deploy and manage Azure Stack in remote locations like factories, oil rigs, retail locations, warehouses, and all edges in between. Avanade offers Azure Stack Hub deployments using HPE’s EdgeLine 8000, a small form factor hub that doesn’t require external cooling, making it ideal for locations like retail or manufacturing where a data center may not be available on site. Pairing Azure Stack Hub and HPE’s EdgeLine 8000 allows for cloud services to run in new locations.

Learn more
